article.headline: Tankersley scores 15 as Alcorn State downs Arkansas-Pine Bluff 79-60
article.description: — Marcus Tankersley scored 15 points as Alcorn State beat Arkansas-Pine Bluff 79-60 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Tankersley scores 15 as Alcorn State downs Arkansas-Pine Bluff 79-60
article.story: LORMAN, Miss. -- — Marcus Tankersley scored 15 points as Alcorn State beat Arkansas-Pine Bluff 79-60 on Saturday night. Tankersley shot 4 of 8 from the field and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line for the Braves (6-17, 6-4 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Mike Pajeaud scored 12 points and added 12 rebounds. Davian Williams also scored 12 points. Doctor Bradley led the Golden Lions (4-19, 1-9) in scoring, finishing with 15 points, nine rebounds, four assists, six steals and two blocks. Chop Paljor added 12 points for UAPB. Zach Reinhart had nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
